from typing import Iterable

import polars as pl

from seedcase_sprout.core.properties import FieldType

# Frictionless types listed in order of precedence for reverse lookups, i.e. when
# mapping a single Polars type back to a single Frictionless type. A Polars type is
# compared against these Frictionless types in order, and the first match determines
# the Frictionless type. See `_polars_to_frictionless()`.
_FRICTIONLESS_TYPES: tuple[FieldType, ...] = (
    # Primary types: reverse lookup always gives back Frictionless type
    "number",
    "integer",
    "string",
    "date",
    "datetime",
    "time",
    "boolean",
    # Secondary types: reverse lookup gives back Frictionless type only if
    # primary type doesn't take precedence
    "array",
    "object",
    # Tertiary types: reverse lookup never gives back Frictionless type
    "geopoint",
    "geojson",
    "year",
    "yearmonth",
    "duration",
    # Fallback type
    "any",
)


def _check_datatype(field_type: FieldType, dtype: pl.DataType) -> bool:
    """Check if a Polars type is an allowed representation of a Frictionless type.

    There are often multiple allowed Polars types for a single Frictionless type.

    Args:
        field_type: The Frictionless type.
        dtype: The Polars type.

    Returns:
        Whether the Polars type is an allowed representation of the Frictionless type.
    """
    match field_type:
        case "number":
            return dtype.is_float() or dtype.is_decimal()
        case "integer":
            return dtype.is_integer() or isinstance(dtype, pl.Duration)
        case "string":
            return isinstance(dtype, (pl.String, pl.Categorical, pl.Enum, pl.Binary))
        case "date":
            return isinstance(dtype, pl.Date)
        case "datetime":
            return isinstance(dtype, pl.Datetime)
        case "time":
            return dtype == pl.Time  # Polars stores Time as a class
        case "boolean":
            return isinstance(dtype, pl.Boolean)
        case "array":
            return isinstance(dtype, (pl.String, pl.Array, pl.List))
        case "object":
            return isinstance(dtype, (pl.String, pl.Struct, pl.Object))
        case "geopoint":
            return (
                isinstance(dtype, pl.Array)
                and dtype.size == 2
                and dtype.inner.is_numeric()
            )
        case "geojson":
            return isinstance(dtype, (pl.String, pl.Struct, pl.Object))
        case "year":
            return dtype.is_integer()
        case "yearmonth":
            return isinstance(dtype, pl.Date)
        case "duration":
            return isinstance(dtype, pl.String)
        case "any":
            return True
        case _:
            return False
